tasks.title: Nmap SMB Scan
tasks.description: Basic port check and script scan for SMB.

tasks.title: SMBClient Anonymous/Guest Enumeration
tasks.description: Attempt to list shares using blank credentials or the guest account.

tasks.title: Check SMB Signing (Relay Targets)
tasks.description: Scan the target to see if SMB signing is disabled. If so, it is vulnerable to NTLM relay attacks.

tasks.title: Enum4Linux Recon
tasks.description: Run Enum4Linux for comprehensive share, user, and domain enumeration.

tasks.title: SMBMap Share & Permission Listing
tasks.description: Quickly list every share the account can reach alongside its actual read/write permissions in one pass, which is faster to eyeball than connecting to each share individually with smbclient.

tasks.title: Connect & Loot Shares
tasks.description: Connect to a specific accessible share. Use 'get' to download files and 'put' to test upload permissions.

tasks.title: Recursive Share Dump
tasks.description: Pull down an entire share in one shot (e.g. to grep offline for KeePass files, configs, or credentials) instead of browsing manually.

tasks.title: Deep Share Crawling (Spider_Plus)
tasks.description: Use NetExec's spider_plus module to recursively map out all readable files on the target's SMB shares.

tasks.title: Enumerate Users & Sessions
tasks.description: Pull a list of all domain users or find out exactly who is currently logged into this machine.

tasks.title: Password Spraying (NetExec)
tasks.description: Use NetExec to spray user lists and custom wordlists against SMB. Add --local-auth when testing local (non-domain) accounts, e.g. a shared local admin password across hosts.

tasks.title: RPCClient Connect
tasks.description: Attempt connection to the RPC endpoint (Null or Authenticated).

tasks.title: RPC Info Gathering
tasks.description: Commands to execute once connected to the rpcclient prompt to dump users, groups, and reset passwords.

tasks.title: Impacket RPC/SAM Dumps
tasks.description: Use Impacket to dump RPC endpoints and SAM data automatically with known credentials.

tasks.title: Generate NTLM Theft Payload
tasks.description: Generate malicious files (like .lnk or .scf) to upload to a writable share to force authentication back to you.

tasks.title: Responder & NTLMRelayX
tasks.description: Catch hashes with Responder, or relay them directly. If SMB signing is disabled, relay with SOCKS to tunnel tools like proxychains.

tasks.title: Host SMB Server for File Transfer
tasks.description: Host an SMB server on Kali to transfer files to/from the target.

tasks.title: NetExec File Transfer (--get-file / --put-file)
tasks.description: Fallback when in-session upload/download (evil-winrm, iwr, certutil) is broken or blocked by AV/AMSI. Transfers the file directly over the authenticated SMB/admin$ connection using your existing creds.

tasks.title: NetExec Pseudo-Shell
tasks.description: Quickly execute a single command across the target via SMB without dropping an interactive shell.

tasks.title: Impacket PsExec
tasks.description: Gain an interactive SYSTEM shell using administrative credentials or NTLM hashes.

tasks.title: Impacket WMIExec / SMBExec
tasks.description: Execute commands stealthily via WMI or SMBExec (bypasses some AV compared to PsExec).

tasks.title: Dump SAM & LSA Secrets
tasks.description: Extract local password hashes and LSA secrets from the registry.

tasks.title: Dump NTDS.dit (Domain Controllers)
tasks.description: If the target is a Domain Controller and you have DA privileges, dump the entire Active Directory database.

tasks.title: Dump LSASS Memory
tasks.description: Extract cleartext passwords and Kerberos tickets directly from LSASS memory.

tasks.title: Extract DPAPI Masterkeys
tasks.description: Hunt for DPAPI masterkeys and browser cookies.

tasks.title: EternalBlue (MS17-010) Check
tasks.description: Scan for the MS17-010 vulnerability, which allows unauthenticated remote code execution as SYSTEM.

tasks.title: ZeroLogon (CVE-2020-1472) Check
tasks.description: Check if a Domain Controller is vulnerable to ZeroLogon.

tasks.title: PrintNightmare / noPac Checks
tasks.description: Scan for PrintNightmare (CVE-2021-1675) and noPac (CVE-2021-42287) vulnerabilities.
